body:
A human resizes an element on a UI/UX design by dragging its border, as asked in feature:c3bed08cc1bbbbb8.

### Do

- Dragging a selected element's border sets its width or height to a fixed size, saved the same way as task:cc33d4301e06e612.
- A size the rules refuse is not saved, and the element goes back to its saved size.

Ask the human how a border is grabbed, and whether a drag can return a size to fill or hug.

### Acceptance

- Tests for the size a drag produces, and that a refusal restores the element.
- A browser check of a drag; say in the task note if it has to be manual.
- Update the README.

### Left out

Moving elements, and the Architecture tab.
title: edit: resize by dragging a border
